name: kaleidoscope-mcp-server

tools.name: preview_responsive
tools.description: Open a URL for responsive preview across multiple device sizes in Kaleidoscope. Returns the Kaleidoscope UI URL and status of each device preview. Automatically starts Kaleidoscope services if not running.

devices.description: Optional list of device IDs to preview. Defaults to all devices. Available: iphone-14, samsung-s21, pixel-6, ipad, ipad-pro, macbook-air, desktop, desktop-4k

tools.name: kaleidoscope_status
tools.description: Check if Kaleidoscope services are running and get their URLs.

tools.name: kaleidoscope_list_devices
tools.description: List the available Kaleidoscope device presets and the default screenshot set. Use this before capture_screenshots when you want to show users the supported devices or ask which devices they want.

tools.name: capture_screenshots
tools.description: Capture screenshots of a URL across multiple device viewport sizes. Returns screenshot metadata, local file paths, file URIs, chat-ready local markdown paths, and inline previews when practical. Includes native MCP image previews for image-capable clients; local Markdown rendering depends on the chat client. Requires Kaleidoscope server to be running.

devices.description: Device viewports to capture. Accepts device IDs or names, for example "iphone-14" or "iPhone 14". Defaults to iphone-14, ipad, desktop. Available IDs: iphone-14, iphone-15, iphone-16, iphone-17, samsung-s21, samsung-s24, samsung-s24-ultra, samsung-s25-ultra, pixel-6, ipad, ipad-pro, macbook-air, desktop, desktop-4k

output_dir.description: Directory name to save screenshots under the configured screenshot root. Defaults to ./screenshots/. Path traversal is rejected by the server.

full_page.description: Capture full scrollable page instead of just the viewport. Default: false

wait_until.description: Navigation readiness. Defaults to domcontentloaded; networkidle can time out on pages with ongoing requests.

settle_ms.description: Delay before capture after navigation. Defaults to 500 ms.

retention_minutes.description: Automatically delete saved images and chat copies after this many minutes. Defaults to the server setting (5 minutes). Use 0 to keep files.

tools.name: compare_screenshots
tools.description: Compare two PNG screenshots pixel by pixel and write a highlighted diff image. Use paths returned by capture_screenshots for the same device and capture mode. Returns exact mismatch counts, percentage, a thresholded verdict, and a chat-ready diff artifact.

baseline_path.description: Absolute or screenshot-root-relative PNG path returned by an earlier capture_screenshots call.

current_path.description: Absolute or screenshot-root-relative PNG path returned by a later capture_screenshots call.

color_threshold.description: Per-pixel perceptual color threshold. Lower is more sensitive. Defaults to 0.1.

allowed_diff_percentage.description: Maximum changed-pixel percentage still considered unchanged. Defaults to 0.

include_antialiasing.description: Count anti-aliased pixel differences instead of ignoring them. Defaults to false.

retention_minutes.description: Automatically delete saved images and chat copies after this many minutes. Defaults to the server setting (5 minutes). Use 0 to keep files.

tools.name: discover_page_elements
tools.description: Discover likely page elements from a natural-language query and return scored selector candidates. Use this before inspect_element_source when you know the element semantically, such as "save button" or "hero section", but do not know the CSS selector yet.

url.description: The local URL to inspect, for example http://localhost:3000/checkout

query.description: A natural-language hint like "save button", "hero section", or "email field".

device.description: Optional device viewport to emulate before scanning the page for candidate elements.

limit.description: Maximum number of candidates to return. Defaults to 5.

tools.name: inspect_element_source
tools.description: Inspect a single element on a local page by CSS selector and return structured source resolution data. This uses Kaleidoscope server-side browser automation, so it can capture page metadata and device viewport context without manual UI clicking. Use this when you know the selector you want to inspect and want the same source payload exposed by the Kaleidoscope inspect panel JSON export.

url.description: The local URL to inspect, for example http://localhost:3000/checkout

selector.description: A CSS selector for the element to inspect, for example #save-button or main > section.hero

device.description: Optional device viewport to emulate before resolving the selector. If omitted, the page is inspected using the browser default viewport.

source_dir.description: Optional source directory used for heuristic source matching. Must be inside KALEIDOSCOPE_WORKSPACE_ROOT on the server.

tools.name: kaleidoscope_read_layout
tools.description: Capture a structured, source-attributed layout snapshot across one or more Kaleidoscope device viewports. Use this before editing UI code to create a baseline for the post-edit layout loop. The capture avoids generated class/id selectors where possible and includes selector-independent fallback keys for diffing.

url.description: The URL to capture. Local dev URLs and Kaleidoscope proxy URLs are supported.

devices.description: Device viewports to capture. Accepts device IDs or names. Defaults to iphone-14, ipad, desktop. Available IDs: iphone-14, iphone-15, iphone-16, iphone-17, samsung-s21, samsung-s24, samsung-s24-ultra, samsung-s25-ultra, pixel-6, ipad, ipad-pro, macbook-air, desktop, desktop-4k

source_dir.description: Optional source directory used to keep later source attribution scoped to the app workspace.

max_elements.description: Maximum visible elements to capture per device. Defaults to 100.

include_source.description: Whether to try runtime source attribution with element-source. Defaults to true.

wait_until.description: Playwright navigation readiness signal. Defaults to networkidle.

settle_ms.description: Extra delay after navigation before reading layout. Defaults to 250.

tools.name: kaleidoscope_after_edit
tools.description: Recapture layout after a UI edit and compare it with a baseline from kaleidoscope_read_layout. Call this only after the target dev server has rebuilt or reloaded; this tool intentionally does not wait for reload events. Returns a terse noChange verdict when nothing visible changed, or a source-attributed summary when layout/text changed.

baseline_capture_id.description: The baseline capture ID returned by kaleidoscope_read_layout before editing.

url.description: Optional URL override. Defaults to the baseline capture URL.

devices.description: Optional device IDs or names to recapture. Defaults to the devices from the baseline capture.

source_dir.description: Optional source directory override. Defaults to the baseline capture source_dir.

max_elements.description: Maximum visible elements to capture per device. Defaults to 100.

include_source.description: Whether to try runtime source attribution with element-source. Defaults to true.

wait_until.description: Playwright navigation readiness signal. Defaults to networkidle.

settle_ms.description: Extra delay after navigation before reading layout. Defaults to 250.

tools.name: kaleidoscope_scan_breakpoints
tools.description: Sweep a page through a continuous viewport-width range and return only concrete responsive failures. The first deterministic checks detect document-level horizontal overflow and visible interactive controls clipped horizontally. Use this to discover failing sampled width ranges beyond the fixed device presets. A clear result means no supported failure was detected, not that every visual issue is impossible.

url.description: The local or public HTTP/HTTPS page to scan.

min_width.description: Smallest viewport width to scan. Defaults to 320.

max_width.description: Largest viewport width to scan. Defaults to 1440.

step.description: Width increment between probes. Defaults to 16. A smaller step is more precise but slower.

height.description: Viewport height used for every width. Defaults to 900.

settle_ms.description: Delay after each resize before measurement. Defaults to 100.

wait_until.description: Navigation readiness signal. Defaults to domcontentloaded; use networkidle only for pages that become idle.
